task.description: Applied REQ-237's PROVENANCE marker convention (lib/letflow/design/req237-zig-provenance-marking-convention.md section 2 placement rule, section 2(a) regex, section 4 worked examples, 2026-09-05 amendment's chunking table) to chunk 239-design-g of lib/letflow/design/: the 13 files req178-dlq-routes.md through req202-artifact-repository.md. Inserted the fixed marker line 'PROVENANCE (historical, not current decision authority):' immediately above the smallest enclosing citation unit for every .zig source-path citation in these 13 files -- single lines, whole paragraphs (marker becomes the paragraph's leading line, per the design's own moduledoc worked example), bullet/numbered list items (marker merged as the leading line of the same list item, preserving bullet/number and citation text unaltered), and whole tables (marker as a standalone line immediately above the table's header row). No citation text was edited, deleted, or reordered. Did not touch CLAUDE.md, README.md, docs/migration/README.md, or any lib/letflow/design/ file outside this chunk's 13-file list. Did not flip REQ-270's status in docs/requirements.yaml (ORCH's job after REVIEWER passes).

result.note: BEFORE (grep -c '\.zig' per file, summed): req178=1, req181=1, req182=2, req184=1, req185=2, req188=1, req192=1, req194=1, req195=2, req197=11, req198=6, req200=1, req202=7 -- total 37 .zig-matching lines across the 13 files, zero pre-existing 'PROVENANCE (historical, not current decision authority):' markers confirmed before starting. AFTER: identical per-file .zig counts (total still 37, confirming no citation line lost or duplicated) and 31 total marker lines inserted (per-file marker counts: req178=1, req181=1, req182=2, req184=1, req185=2, req188=1, req192=1, req194=1, req195=2, req197=9, req198=5, req200=1, req202=4 -- fewer markers than .zig lines in the dense files because several .zig substrings share one citation unit, e.g. a paragraph or table citing 2-3 .zig files at once, per the design's own unit-collapsing rule). Sample-diffed via `git diff` on 6 of the 13 files (req182, req185, req188, req197, req198, req202) covering all ~24 citations in those files (well over the 10-citation/5-file minimum) plus the remaining 7 files (req178, req181, req184, req192, req194, req195, req200) diffed in full as well since the chunk was small enough -- every hunk shows only the marker line added, with the pre-existing citation text reflowed onto a following line byte-identical, never altered or removed. Divergence-line check: `grep -rnE 'unlike R-Co|deliberately diverges|diverges from R-Co'` returns the same single hit both before and after (req194-prometheus-metrics.md, 'Staleness decision: YES, expose it -- unlike R-Co.'), only its line number shifted from 420 to 421 because one marker line was inserted earlier in that same file -- text byte-identical. Scope confirmation: `git diff --stat` / `git status --short` show exactly the 13 target files changed, nothing else -- CLAUDE.md, README.md, docs/migration/README.md, and every other lib/letflow/design/ file are untouched. STRUCTURAL EDGE CASES ENCOUNTERED (flagging for REVIEWER's explicit re-verification, per this run's own instruction to call these out specifically): (1) Two Markdown-blockquote citations, in req178-dlq-routes.md (line 13, a '> R-Co's `dlq.zig`...' moduledoc-mandated quote block) and req192-service-catalog-routes.md (line 21, a '> R-Co's `src/api/routes/services.zig`...' quote block) -- handled identically to REQ-269's own precedent by inserting a '> '-prefixed marker line ('> PROVENANCE (historical, not current decision authority):') as the new first line of the blockquote, preserving blockquote syntax rather than breaking it with a bare line. (2) Bulleted and numbered list items carrying a .zig citation (found in req182, req185, req188, req197 x6, req198 x2, req202 x2) -- these were NOT handled with a bare marker line preceding the list item (which would have split the list into two adjacent lists at that point), but instead with the marker merged as the leading line of the SAME list item/bullet, immediately after the '-'/'N.' marker and before the item's original first line, by direct analogy to the design doc's own section-4 worked example where the marker becomes 'the first line of the... unit' for a moduledoc paragraph. This keeps each citation's bullet/number and text fully intact and unaltered, just with the marker occupying the item's first physical line and the original citation text following on the next (still within the same list item, same indentation). (3) Two Markdown tables carrying a .zig citation only in one row each (req197's section-9 moduledoc-content table, row AC10; req197's section-11 traceability table, row 10) -- per the design's explicit 'whole table is one citation unit, one marker above the header row, never one marker per row' rule, a single marker line was inserted as a standalone paragraph immediately above each table's header row, not inside the table and not duplicated per row. Files touched (all 13, exactly the chunk's scope): lib/letflow/design/req178-dlq-routes.md, lib/letflow/design/req181-webhooks-core.md, lib/letflow/design/req182-webhooks-routes.md, lib/letflow/design/req184-webhook-deliveries-route.md, lib/letflow/design/req185-scheduler-firing-architecture.md, lib/letflow/design/req188-recurring-timers-and-retention.md, lib/letflow/design/req192-service-catalog-routes.md, lib/letflow/design/req194-prometheus-metrics.md, lib/letflow/design/req195-audit-entry-storage.md, lib/letflow/design/req197-expr-arithmetic-and-errors.md, lib/letflow/design/req198-expr-builtin-functions.md, lib/letflow/design/req200-instance-timeline-rendering.md, lib/letflow/design/req202-artifact-repository.md.
